name: voice-worker
description: Always-running voice worker for Business Pilot AI's direct voice runtime: Twilio Media Streams -> OpenAI Realtime -> the shared dispatchTool() -> Supabase. Deployed separately from the Next.js app (which stays on Vercel) because a phone call is a long-lived bidirectional connection, not a request/response workload. Part of the business-pilot-ai npm workspace so it shares one node_modules with the root app and can import lib/ava-dispatcher.ts directly -- never a duplicated copy of the business logic.
